blocks.title: Search algorithm
blocks.text: Search algorithms find specific elements, or sets of elements, within a dataset. They are critical for information retrieval, database queries and decision-making.

blocks.prompt: Give two everyday uses of search algorithms.
blocks.explanation: Finding a contact in a phone and looking up a record in a database (or a page with a search engine).

items: Search algorithms find items in data: information retrieval, database queries, decisions.
